_specs: Nothing about this product's construction is published. Unverifiable rows are marked, not guessed.
buyBody: An oversized putter grip in four sizes, clover. A fat grip takes the wrists out of the stroke, which is why the Tracer ships with one fitted as standard. Every size is out of stock at the moment.

details.headline: Quiet hands hole more short putts
paras: The wrists are what turn a four-footer into a five-footer coming back. A thicker grip makes them harder to use, which for most golfers is an improvement.
It is the smallest change that measurably affects putting, and the one most people never try.

details.headline: 1.0 to 5.0
paras: Four sizes, and the number is the diameter step rather than anything standardised across the industry. Bigger is quieter.
All four are sold out at the moment.
